en.title: Maximum Health from Selecting Server Types
en.description:
Choose at most m server types; once a type is chosen, every server of that type is selected. Find the maximum total health of the selected servers.

The standard input format, examples and test data were written independently by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n m (1≤m≤n≤100000), the second line n health values (1..10⁹), and the third line n type IDs (1..n).
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer required by the problem.
en.explanation: Example 1: type 1 has total health 4+5=9 and type 2 has 5+6=11; when only one type can be chosen, take type 2. Example 2: the only server has health 8. Example 3: there are only two types and up to 3 may be chosen, so choose both, for a total of 1+2+3=6.
hints: Sum the health per type, sort the type totals in descending order and take the top m types.
